description: This file defines the CursorOption interface, which extends the Option interface. It provides methods for retrieving the cursor position for query resumption and generating a string representation of the option. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package.

classes.name: CursorOption
classes.description: An interface representing the 'cursor' option used to resume previous queries with a specific page size.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns the page size or cursor position as a String.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cursor option, formatted as 'size(<value>)'.
